release_name: HyperPulse Toolkit V1.1.0 (Smart Flasher & Module Hub)
author: Adrian (@stickshiftwillyy)
changelog:
HyperPulse Toolkit V1.1.0 Update!
- 🛡️ Smart Flasher & Brick-Guard: Fast metadata pre-flight verification in <0.5s for 7GB+ ROMs!
- 🛑 Automatic Brick Shield: Blocks flash if ROM codename does not match connected phone
- ⚠️ Pre-Flight Safety Checklist & Confirmation modal
- ⏳ First-Boot Reassurance Screen with live elapsed timer (4-7 mins expected boot time)
- 🆘 Bootloop Rescue Assistant: Step-by-step diagnostic guide to resolve bootloops safely
- 🧩 Magisk & KernelSU Module Hub: 1-click ADB injection for Play Integrity Fix, Shamiko, Zygisk, and custom modules
